parlcat2Rep

Development version. The citation, the licence of the data and the maintainer details are drafts.

parlcat2Rep gives R access to Voices of the Republic, the speech corpus of the Parliament of Catalonia during the Spanish Second Republic, from its constitution in December 1932 to its last session in October 1938:

  • 32,666 speeches in 259 sessions, 4.57 million words;
  • for every speech, the person who delivers it, their party on the date and the office they hold;
  • the reference tables used to build these assignments (MPs, parties, governments, offices, party changes) and the record of the human review.

The text comes from the Diari de Sessions del Parlament de Catalunya, published by the Parliament of Catalonia, transcribed with OCR and split into speeches.

Installation 

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("hunsao/parlcat2Rep")

Speech metadata and reference tables are bundled with the package. The text of the speeches (about 6 MB) is downloaded once and cached:

library(parlcat2Rep)
parl_download()

Usage 

# Speeches by the Lliga in 1934, without the text
parl_speeches(year = 1934, party = "LR", text = FALSE)

# Who governed, and with which parties, on a given date
parl_government_on("1934-01-05")

# Search the text (accent and case insensitive)
parl_search("rabassaires", include_chair = FALSE)
parl_kwic("Estatut", window = 8, year = 1932)

# Frequency of a term over time, by government and opposition
parl_trend("ordre públic", group = "side") |>
  parl_plot_trend()

# Text-analysis formats
corp <- parl_as_corpus(parl_speeches(year = 1936))   # quanteda
toks <- parl_tidy(parl_speeches(year = 1938))        # tidytext

Before counting, read the warnings in the methodology article: use party_data (party on the date), not party (1932 ticket); decide whether to include the speeches made while chairing the session; and remember that readings by the secretary and anonymous headings are excluded by default.

Problems and suggestions

Please report errors in the data or the package, or suggest improvements, at https://github.com/hunsao/parlcat2Rep/issues.

How to cite

Draft citation (not final):

Rodon, Toni, and David Carbonell. 2026. Voices of the Republic: A Speech Corpus of the Parliament of Catalonia (1932–1938). Version 1.0. VEARLYDEM Project, Universitat Pompeu Fabra. DOI pending.

In R: citation("parlcat2Rep").
